receipts.stop_condition: Do not promote missing payer, displacement, baseline, price, programme ID, or Atlas roles.

receipts.fallback: Synthetic conformance and public-context analysis only
Preserve all values, choose no value, and defer pending custodian adjudication
receipts.stop_condition: Do not average or silently select conflicting records.

receipts.fallback: Use public aggregate context where rights permit

negative_receipt_policy: A negative, not-held, refused, redacted, inaccessible, or restricted result is evidence about search/availability scope only; it is never converted into zero, absence of a programme, or an empirical parameter.
refresh_rule: Reacquire when a source becomes accessible, a new publication appears, a custodian responds, or terms/revisions change.
